nodes.summary: Infinite-sites mutation at rate `θ/2` per lineage per unit time: if the number of segregating sites `S` is integrable and has conditional mean `(θ/2) L` given the genealogy σ-algebra `m`, then `E S = θ H_{n-1}`. (Integrability matters: Mathlib's conditional expectation of a non-integrable function is `0`.)

nodes.summary: Kingman's coalescent for a sample of size `n`, through its holding times: `T k` is the time (in units of `2N` generations) during which the genealogy has exactly `k` lineages, for `2 ≤ k ≤ n`. These are independent, and `T k` is exponential with rate `k.choose 2`. The values of `T k` for `k ∉ [2, n]` are irrelevant.
nodes.title: Holding times of Kingman's coalescent

nodes.summary: `noCoalProb M k` is the falling factorial `M (M-1) ⋯ (M-k+1)` divided by `M ^ k`.
nodes.title: No-coalescence probability as a falling factorial ratio

nodes.summary: In a Wright–Fisher population of `M` gene copies, the probability that `k` lineages, choosing their parents independently and uniformly, have `k` distinct parents.
nodes.title: Probability of no coalescence in one Wright–Fisher generation

nodes.summary: The coordinate projections of `piMeasure n` form a Kingman coalescent; in particular `KingmanTimes` is inhabited for every sample size.
nodes.title: Kingman coalescent from coordinate projections

nodes.summary: The canonical probability space for the Kingman holding times of a sample of size `n`: the product of the exponential laws `Exp (k.choose 2)`, `2 ≤ k ≤ n`.
nodes.title: Canonical probability space for Kingman holding times

nodes.summary: `∑_{k=2}^n (k.choose 2)⁻¹ = 2 (1 - 1/n)` for `n ≥ 1` (telescoping `2/(k(k-1))`).
nodes.title: Sum of reciprocals of binomial coefficients $\binom{k}{2}$
Weighted sum of reciprocals of $\binom{k}{2}$ is twice a harmonic number

nodes.summary: For `M` gene copies (`M = 2N`), the per-generation probability that some of `k` lineages coalesce is `(k.choose 2) / M + o(1/M)`; i.e. in time units of `M` generations, coalescences occur at rate `k.choose 2`.
nodes.title: Kingman's coalescence rate

nodes.summary: `noCoalProb M k → 1` as `M → ∞`.
nodes.title: No-coalescence probability tends to one

nodes.summary: After `⌊t M⌋` Wright–Fisher generations (`t ≥ 0` coalescent time units), the probability that `k` lineages have not coalesced tends to `exp (-(k.choose 2) t)`, the survival function of the exponential law with rate `k.choose 2`.
nodes.title: Wright–Fisher coalescence times converge to exponential laws
